relations.subject: sgw:custom-scope
relations.evidence: Sync Gateway targets the same ceiling for a database's custom scope: up to 1000 custom collections.

notable_absence.finding: The predicate list has no way to state a numeric ceiling on how many of a concept can exist (e.g. 'up to 1000 scopes and up to 1000 collections per cluster', 'Sync Gateway targets... up to 1000 custom collections'). requiresMinimumNodeCount exists for MINIMUM node counts as a datatype property, but there is no symmetric MAXIMUM-count predicate for other object types (collections, scopes). This page's entire content is two such ceiling statements, so the gap is total for this record - the hasEquivalentEffectAs relation above only captures that the two ceilings match, not either ceiling's actual value.
